subject: Nelix private rollout: ops checklist and VPC endpoint alignment
messages:
From: Amira Kahn <amira.kahn@nelixhealth.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
Cc: Chris Lopez <chris.lopez@cloudhub.io>
Date: Fri, 02 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Kickoff: Nelix private stack rollout — initial inventory

Hi Hannah,

Thanks for taking this on. We're ready to start the private/on-prem rollout prep for Nelix. Attached is our interim network inventory (CSV) and a high-level diagram. High level asks from our side: VPC peering or private endpoints guidance, IP ranges we'll need to reserve, and the approach for secrets (KMS/HSM) since we run a hybrid environment.

Can we get a short technical alignment session this week (30 min)? CTAs:
- Share required CIDR ranges and firewall rules
- Confirm whether Redwood supports route-based peering vs. private endpoints for our topology
- Preflight checklist for staging hardware and proxy/NAT requirements

Thanks — happy to loop in our infra lead if helpful.

Best,
Amira Kahn
Head of Infrastructure, Nelix Health
amira.kahn@nelixhealth.com
attachments: nelix_network_inventory_v1.csv, network-diagram-v2.png

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: Amira Kahn <amira.kahn@nelixhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.ai>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 02 Apr 2027 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Kickoff: Nelix private stack rollout — initial inventory

Amira — thanks for the inventory. I reviewed the CSV and the diagram; good level of detail.

Quick answers / next steps:
- We can support both VPC peering and Private Service Endpoints. For predictable latency and avoiding cross-account routing complexity I'd recommend Private Endpoints for the Redwood control plane and a VPC peering for model-serving clusters (we'll outline ports).
- Please confirm your public CIDR blocks and the internal ranges you want reserved for the private endpoints (we usually reserve /28 per endpoint).
- For secrets: Redwood can integrate with customer KMS/HSM via our Private deployment. We'll need an API-level proof-of-possession step and a KMS admin contact.

I scheduled a 30-min tech sync for Fri 14:00 PT — invite sent. Diego will run the preflight checklist; Marissa will own the project plan and timelines; Evelyn will coordinate the on-prem package deliverables.

Attaching our private on-prem intake PDF so you have the fields we need filled out.

Cheers,
Hannah Schmitt
Sr. Customer Success, Redwood Inference
attachments: redwood_private_onprem_intake.pdf

3) Shared runbook skeleton (Marissa) — Fri noon

Subject: Re: Internal: Nelix rollout — owner tasks & timeline

Quick tech notes after scanning their inventory and diagram:
- They are on a hybrid setup with on-prem VLANs and a cloud VPC for backups. Recommendation: Private Endpoints for control-plane (mTLS + fixed IPs) and VPC peering for high-throughput model traffic. Peering avoids double-NAT for large blob transfers.
- Need their NAT/gateway details and any egress proxy IPs — the preflight script checks connectivity to our private endpoints and validates MTU, iptables, and TLS cipher suites.
- I'll attach the preflight script and a sample firewall rules snippet. Diego will run this against their staging box next Tuesday morning.
